title: DrivingGPT: Unifying Driving World Modeling and Planning with Multi-Modal Autoregressive Transformers

output_modality.value: single-view (front camera) video via discrete image tokens, plus ego action tokens (planned trajectory); optional SVD decoder refines to 1024x576 video

control_signal.value: frame-wise relative ego actions (dx, dy, yaw) quantised into tokens, interleaved with image tokens in history

control_mechanism.value: token conditioning: image and action tokens form one unified vocabulary and sequence, modelled by next-token prediction with causal attention and frame-wise 1D rotary embeddings

base_model.value: Llama-like autoregressive transformer (LlamaGen structure) trained from scratch; pretrained VQ-VAE image tokenizer; optional SVD video diffusion decoder in supplement

datasets.value: nuPlan (front camera, clips of 16 frames at 10Hz) and NAVSIM (navtrain for training, navtest and navmini for testing)

metrics.value: Video: FVD and FID. Planning: PDMS with NC, DAC, TTC, comfort and EP subscores.

controllability_evidence.value: Table 1 on navtest: FVD 142.61 and FID 12.78 versus fine-tuned SVD 227.54 and 24.03. Action-condition understanding in long videos shown qualitatively; PDMS 65.3 to 82.4 with position embedding on actions.

closed_loop.value: No: planning is scored on NAVSIM with a 4-second non-reactive simulation; long videos of 64 frames (32 s) are generated autoregressively but not rolled out with a policy in closed loop.

stated_limitations.value: Only the front camera is used, leaving surround cameras, LiDAR and IMU for future work; ego status is deliberately excluded. No explicit limitations section in the packet.

notes: Joint world model and planner; action-conditioned generation is claimed but not isolated by a dedicated action-following metric in the packet.
